cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum, I've initialled the lease where you did. We're moving in together. Say it's good news before I open the wine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I signed as a witness. You don't need permission from me to live with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the witness. I still want my mother to be pleased about our home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you toast both of us, then? I'd like our first toast to include the two people who'll live there.
